owner: Copilot, preparing the RC5 evidence assessment requested by @pedrosakuma

changes.rationale: Reviewed bf2274dc..f8c7ac87: no shipping source or root build/dependency changes. From archive approval bd99630d onward, the four ledgers, qualification artifacts, observation policies and gap contracts are unchanged; only the authority implementation hash changed, not its evaluation instant. The exact archive/GHCR inputs and four observation bundles reproduce the committed RC5 identity and final manifest. Later changes concern diagnostic instrumentation, OIDC assertion rotation/cleanup and promotion tooling, not the sealed bytes. S3 provisioning now explicitly disables versioning for future runs; it neither rewrites nor invalidates the original basic-CRUD evidence. The selected rollback target and persisted-format inventory remain unchanged. Review of this decision does not approve a different runtime or topology. Publication follow-up: run 37013616548/1 passed the gate but GitHub refused draft creation with its workflow token. The dedicated RELEASE_PUBLISH_TOKEN fix changes publication authentication only, not evidence or Azure authentication; GITHUB_TOKEN keeps read access and GHCR package writes. The exact candidate's tag-triggered workflows were inspected to exclude a stable source rebuild. This input review accepts that scoped workflow change without renewing canonical measurements.

incidents.rationale: No unresolved evidence-invalidating incident identified in the repository issues and retained results reviewed on 2026-10-02. This is not a claim that every incident is resolved or that Azure is healthy everywhere. #1049 is closed test isolation; #1066/#1072 are closed runner/cleanup authentication defects, not proof of a fix for the historical SecretsManager workload 403. #1016 remains an accepted floor-calibration follow-up; the historical 403 cause remains unknown and is explicitly accepted for this release on the strength of the exact candidate's passing canonical lifecycle/credential-rotation evidence, not absence of recurrence alone. #1062's large DynamoDB/S3 gaps did not recur under controlled conditions, with diagnostic limitations retained. #1024 is report-only batch-cost research; #1025 is a preview watch, neither an identified basic-CRUD defect. No current capacity or universal health claim is being added, so no additional paid health/load check is selected solely for age. Any newly reported relevant defect, authentication recurrence, contract/config change or revocation requires reassessment before publication.

profiles.rationale: Reuse the unchanged basic-CRUD qualification and passing 60-minute observation 36463787285/1, with original thresholds, exact runtime/prior and provenance. The controlled ABBA+A/A diagnostic 36637714583/1 did not reproduce the historical large gap; it is supporting attribution evidence, not a new qualification, parity proof or current capacity guarantee. No shipping/persisted-format/profile change or known basic-CRUD-invalidating defect was found. BatchWriteItem attribution research #1024 and distributed-transactions preview #1025 do not require repeating this scope. No new paid check is justified solely by the old 72-hour boundary.

Reuse the unchanged basic-object-CRUD qualification and passing 60-minute observation 36473482616/1. Controlled diagnostic 36941305177/1 did not reproduce the historical roughly 29% deficit on the same runner/backend. Accept its descriptive comparison only: four nominal 30-second waits were short by at most 1.0362 ms, so it does not prove a strict minimum-wait invariant, equivalence or historical causality. The failed first diagnostic 36930800624/1 produced no measurement; #1076 fixed diagnostic preflight rather than shipping behavior. Neither diagnostic substitutes for canonical evidence. No new code/config claim or evidence-invalidating defect requires a new paid run.

Reuse the unchanged lifecycle qualification, including its real-Azure credential-rotation scenario (three completions, zero failures), and passing 60-minute observation 36455379008/1. Accept 4.5 as the existing observation override only; do not call the old runner-contention explanation established or require five workers to exceed the eight-worker qualification floor of 9. The completed 5/8 comparison 36875986895/1 supports scaling, not recalibration; its overall workflow remains failed due to cleanup. Historical workload 403 causality is unknown, not claimed fixed. That residual uncertainty and #1016 calibration follow-up are accepted for this workload-scoped release; renewed auth failures invalidate reuse. No repeat diagnostic or automatic floor change is required.

Reuse the unchanged standard-messaging qualification and passing 60-minute observation 36426059230/1. The earlier failed assembly run 36407354825/1 remains ineligible; #1059 fixed the schema-2 assembler guard and the selected successful run is a distinct execution. #1049 was resolved test-fixture isolation, not a shipping cache regression. Exact candidate, attested prior, messaging scope and policies are unchanged and no relevant unresolved defect was identified. Repeating qualification/observation merely for elapsed time would add no targeted evidence for an identified risk.
